question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When the separatist tendencies become very active, the unity of any nation can be in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**peril.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank in the sentence will imply how the separatist tendencies can make the unity of the nation to be in danger.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "peril."** 
 
 
• "Peril" means danger or risk.(जोखिम)
 
• It is a noun and can be used to describe a situation where something is in danger.
 
 
• Example: The country's economy is in great peril.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "in peril" means the unity of a nation is in danger when separatist tendencies become active.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Solitaire" refers to a card game or a type of diamond. It is not related to the given sentence.(एक तरह का ताश का खेल)
 
• Option 2: "Docile" means easily managed or obedient. It is not related to the given sentence.(विनम्र)
 
• Option 3: "Negotiation" refers to discussions or talks aimed at reaching an agreement. It is not related to the given sentence.(बातचीत)
